citation: Battezzati A, Foppiani A, Leone A, et al. Acute Insulin Secretory Effects of a Classic Ketogenic Meal in Healthy Subjects: A Randomized Cross-Over Study. Nutrients. 2023.
protocol: Cross-over, 7-day washout: Mediterranean meal vs classic ketogenic meal, each ~40% of individual daily energy need, eaten at 09:00 after >=12 h fast; samples 0,10,20,30,(45),60,90,120,180 min
population: n=12 (6 F, 6 M), age 19-31 y, BMI 19.7-24.7; healthy
note: Time-course table. Mediterranean arm is an ordinary mixed meal; ketogenic arm is unusual (very low carbohydrate) but is a valid dose contrast. Insulin in pmol/L, glucose mg/dL. Table 2 columns show 0,10,20,30,60,90,120,180 min (abstract also lists 45 min).
